item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
The Israeli military has established a permanent presence in depopulated West Bank camps while conducting raids that captured four Islamic Jihad operatives planning attacks and killed five terror operatives in Gaza. Israeli forces also raided Palestinian NGOs in the occupied West Bank and in Ramallah, targeting staff and offices. Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
